title: Homework: four multiplication word problems
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Multiplication and division B; fractions B
source: Written for mathematics/y5 lesson 21 (Four multiplication word problems (teacher's sheet), choosing a method for each.)
intro: Choose a method for each: mental, the grid method or long multiplication. Write which you chose and why.

questions.q: A box holds 48 pencils. How many pencils are in 23 boxes?
A coach has 52 seats. How many seats are there on 14 coaches?
A school buys 36 chairs at £24 each. What is the total cost?
A farmer plants 125 rows with 18 seeds in each row. How many seeds is that?
